basic_info.description: Down-to-the-studs remodel blends modern design with classic charm in the heart of Hayes Valley. Wide-plank white oak floors, recessed lighting, and custom 8' doors frame a light-filled open plan with bay windows and verdant outlooks. The sleek new kitchen features quartz counters, custom cabinetry, under-cabinet lighting, a 6-burner range with hood, Bertazzoni French door fridge, and picture window over the sink. The spacious primary suite offers bay windows, walk-in closet, and spa-like bath with Porcelanosa tile, glass-enclosed shower, and floating vanity. A second quiet bedroom with walk-in closet and guest bath with tub/shower complete the layout. Added comforts include in-unit W/D hookups, forced-air heat, and double-paned windows. Enjoy a lush shared garden and extra storage. Located on Page Street, a designated Slow Street that's bike- and pedestrian-friendly, with unbeatable walkability to Hayes Street, the Valencia Corridor, and Lower Haight cafs, shops, and nightlifeplus easy access to Muni and BART.
